title: Customer Data Recovery

storyline.headline: A credit campaign file contains gaps
storyline.summary: BankWise cannot segment customers while key income fields are blank. Identify and handle the missing values.

objectives: Inspect missing values and prepare a usable income field.
starterCode:
import pandas as pd
customers = pd.read_csv('customers.csv')
hints: fillna() replaces blanks with an appropriate chosen value.
businessInsight: Missing values must be made visible before they silently distort customer decisions.

handbook.heading: Find missing values
handbook.whatItDoes: isna() marks blank cells; sum() counts them.
handbook.useCase: Use it during every data-quality review.

handbook.heading: Fill gaps
handbook.whatItDoes: fillna replaces missing values with a chosen value.
handbook.useCase: Use it only when the replacement is appropriate for the business question.
